rules: Secondary market yield is not the contractual cash coupon
Benchmark resets can occur without renegotiation
New contracts may price financing cost economically; no universal automatic pass-through clause established
Already signed service contracts with undrawn financing can have a funding-price gap
Do not sum June balances and subsequent gross issuance to claim October total debt
Operating leases are distinct from funded debt; avoid applying bond yield to lease liabilities
